#include<iostream>
#include<algorithm>
using namespace std;
using llong = long long;
const llong MOD = 1000000007;

llong fastPow(llong base, llong exp, llong mod) {
    llong result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

llong modPow(llong base, llong exp) {
    return fastPow(base, exp, MOD);
}

int main() {
    llong p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    if (k % p == 1) {
        cout << modPow(p, p);
        return 0;
    }
    
    if (k % p == 0) {
        cout << modPow(p, p - 1);
        return 0;
    }
    
    llong order = 1;
    while ((p - 1) % order != 0 || fastPow(k, order, p) != 1) {
        order++;
    }
    
    cout << modPow(p, (p - 1) / order);
    return 0;
}
